tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List Great Work Labs models with what each does and its price. Optional category filter: understanding, safety, search, transform, audio, vision.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: Options, output fields, limits and real example requests and outputs for one model id (e.g. moat-1).

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: The most a run_model call can cost, without running it or spending anything. Same arguments as run_model.

tools.name: account
tools.description: The connected account's balance, this month's spend, caps and auto top-up, plus a link where the user can add credit.

tools.name: wait_for_credit
tools.description: After showing the user a setup_url: waits (up to 2 minutes) until the account has credit, then returns the balance. Retry your call after it returns ready: true.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "run_model" is 1585 chars, far longer than this server's median (131). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
